prompts.text: What harmless everyday task would make a surprisingly entertaining reality-show challenge?
Our group must run a pop-up café on a reality show for one afternoon. Who gets which job?
A cooking competition with mystery ingredients or a design contest using recycled materials?
Tell us about a reality-show moment where a contestant's reaction was more memorable than the result.
The most enjoyable reality competitions reward teamwork as much as individual talent.
Watching people make decisions under a timer turns ordinary activities into entertainment.
Who in this group would give the most dramatic interview after losing a challenge?
The producers ask us to create a group slogan for our team. What should it be?
Judge a talent competition or participate in a friendly travel challenge?
What reality-show format would you redesign to make it more fun for contestants?
What snack has become part of your favourite watch-party routine?
Tell us about a screening where the audience's reaction surprised you.
We're hosting a watch party for people with different tastes. How do we choose the opening feature?
Themed decorations inspired by the film or a menu inspired by its setting?
A good watch party needs enough time afterwards for everyone to share their theories.
The room sometimes goes completely quiet at the same moment without anyone planning it.
Who here is best at noticing tiny background details in a film?
We need a no-spoiler rule for a weekly series club. How should it work?
A small gathering with a projector or a lively screening at a local cinema?
What would make you want to organise a second watch party immediately after the first?
Which video-game setting would make a hilarious destination for our group holiday?
We're designing a cooperative video game where every player has one ridiculous special skill. What's yours?
A colourful racing game or a puzzle adventure where everyone has to communicate?
Tell us about a game level that made you laugh because your plan failed.
A game is often more entertaining with friends who aren't especially good at it.
The funniest gaming moments sometimes happen when nobody understands the controls yet.
Who here would spend the most time changing their character's outfit before starting the game?
Our group has to design the final level of a light-hearted platform game. What's the obstacle?
Play a retro arcade classic or try an unfamiliar modern party game?
What game mechanic would you remove if you had one day to improve a favourite title?
Which everyday situation would be funniest as a short stage play?
Tell us about a theatre performance where an actor handled an unexpected moment brilliantly.
We get five random objects and two minutes to create a stage scene. What's the setting?
A comedy with a tiny cast or a colourful production with a large ensemble?
An improvised scene gets funnier when performers accept each other's unusual ideas.
A single prop can become an entire character in a clever theatre performance.
Who in this group would make the most expressive narrator in a stage show?
Our audience gives us the location 'a library at midnight'. What should happen in the opening scene?
Watch a play from the front row or see how the same production looks from the balcony?
What's one theatrical trick you'd enjoy seeing explained backstage?
What kind of music would make our group's arrival look dramatic in a film?
We're editing a cheerful montage of a family picnic. What style of soundtrack fits?
A film with a memorable original score or one that uses familiar songs in clever ways?
Tell us about a soundtrack that made a scene feel completely different from what you expected.
A well-placed moment of silence is sometimes the strongest musical choice in a film.
People often remember a movie scene when its music plays somewhere else.
Which ordinary activity would become hilarious with an overly dramatic soundtrack?
We must score a slow-motion scene of someone dropping their shopping bags. What instrument takes the lead?
Create a playlist for a fictional road trip or for a fictional victory parade?
What scene from a favourite show would you like to watch with its music removed?
What unusual award should our group give at the end of a film marathon?
Tell us about an awards-show acceptance speech you remember for an unexpected reason.
We're presenting awards for fictional characters. What's the first category?
A short, funny awards ceremony or a full red-carpet event with elaborate outfits?
An entertaining acceptance speech deserves its own award.
The best award-show reactions sometimes come from people who didn't expect to win.
Who here would prepare a speech for an award they had almost no chance of receiving?
Our group has to host an imaginary awards show with no budget. What should the opening act be?
Vote for the best film ending or the best fictional supporting character?
What playful award would you create for someone who always recommends entertainment to friends?
What part of making a film would you most like to watch from behind the camera?
Tell us about learning how a surprising special effect was made with simple materials.
We have to build a miniature set for a short film using household objects. What location should it represent?
Visit a costume workshop or see how a sound-effects artist works?
Knowing how an effect was achieved often makes the finished scene more impressive.
A tiny production decision can become the detail audiences talk about most.
Who here would enjoy being an extra in a film for a day?
A director asks us to make a crowded street scene with only six performers. What's our trick?
Watch the making-of documentary before a film or after seeing the finished work?
What production job deserves more recognition from ordinary viewers?
What's the funniest theory you've heard about a show that turned out to be completely wrong?
Tell us about a time a tiny clue led you to predict the wrong plot twist.
We have to invent an outrageous but harmless theory about a fictional character. What's the evidence?
Predict the villain from the opening scene or guess the final surprise from the trailer?
A clever wrong prediction can make discussing a story more enjoyable than guessing correctly.
A group can watch the same episode and notice entirely different clues.
Who here would create the longest explanation for a theory nobody else believes?
We're writing a mystery series and want viewers to argue about a clue. What ordinary object should we feature?
Discuss every episode as it releases or wait until the season ends to compare theories?
What's a fictional mystery you'd enjoy debating even if the writers never reveal the answer?
What unusual theme would persuade our group to attend a local entertainment festival?
Tell us about a festival activity you tried mainly because your friends encouraged you.
We're organising a one-day arts festival with three stages. What goes on each stage?
A street-performance festival or a weekend of outdoor cinema screenings?
The best festival programmes leave room for people to stumble upon something unfamiliar.
A small interactive activity sometimes becomes the most talked-about part of a large event.
Who here would volunteer to help run a festival information desk for the day?
Our festival has to include one event that lasts exactly three minutes. What should visitors experience?
Attend several short performances or spend the afternoon at one long headline show?
What's an entertainment event you would happily travel to another city to attend with friends?
Which old form of entertainment would be fun to introduce to people who've never tried it?
Tell us about finding an old game, comic or recording and enjoying it more than expected.
Our group spends an evening using only entertainment options available fifty years ago. What's the plan?
A vintage arcade afternoon or a listening party built around old radio programmes?
An old-fashioned entertainment format can still feel fresh when people experience it together.
Different generations sometimes laugh at the same performance for different reasons.
What entertainment habit from your childhood would look unusual to younger people?
We have to recreate a classic radio drama with no recording equipment. How do we perform the sound effects?
Read an old comic aloud together or try a tabletop game from another decade?
Which forgotten entertainment trend would you enjoy bringing back for a single evening?
